fields.name: media_footerVariant
fields.label: Footer layout
fields.description: Variant A: the photo (or video) behind; the logo, copyright and button at the left, the columns and social icons at the right. Variant B: the black-to-teal gradient (no photo); the logo, copyright and privacy policy at the left, the button in the centre, CONNECT (the social links as text) and the columns at the right. Columns and Icons: add them to this block.

fields.name: media_backgroundMode
fields.label: Background type
fields.description: Image: the background image. Video: the background video, playing muted on a loop (the background image shows until it plays, and instead of it if it cannot). Image and video: both the background image and the background video (shown as Video for now). Note: Background media is only used in Variant A. This field is ignored if Variant B is selected.

fields.name: media_backgroundImage
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Covers the whole footer (with Video, or Image and video: shown until the video plays). Note: Background media is only used in Variant A. This field is ignored if Variant B is selected.

fields.name: media_backgroundImageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty when the image is decoration only. At most 125 characters.

fields.name: media_backgroundVideo
fields.label: Background video
fields.description: An MP4 video from Assets, or its full URL. Used when Background type is Video, or Image and video. Note: Background media is only used in Variant A. This field is ignored if Variant B is selected.

fields.name: brand_logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: The JSW MOTORS wordmark, white.

fields.name: brand_copyright
fields.label: Copyright text
fields.description: Under the logo, e.g. © 2026 JSW Motors  Mumbai, India. At most 60 characters.

fields.name: brand_ctaButton
fields.label: CTA button link
fields.description: Where the white button leads (a page, or #section on one).

fields.name: brand_ctaButtonText
fields.label: CTA button text
fields.description: The "+" after it is added on the page. At most 24 characters.

fields.name: brand_privacyPolicyText
fields.label: Privacy policy text
fields.description: At the foot, on the left. At most 30 characters.

fields.name: brand_socialHeading
fields.label: Social heading
fields.description: Above the social icons, e.g. CONNECT. At most 20 characters.

fields.name: columnHeading
fields.label: Column title
fields.description: e.g. TECHNOLOGY. At most 20 characters.

fields.name: links_link1
fields.label: Link 1 URL
fields.description: A page, #section, or a full URL. A link without a URL is not shown. Warning: Both the text and the URL must be provided. If one is missing, the link will not be displayed on the page.

fields.name: links_link1Text
fields.label: Link 1 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs. At most 24 characters. Warning: Both the text and the URL must be provided. If one is missing, the link will not be displayed on the page.

fields.name: iconImage
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: The network's logo, white on transparent (SVG or PNG). Warning: You can add multiple icons, but a maximum of 4 will be displayed on the live site. Warning: The icon, its network name and its URL must all be provided. If one is missing, the icon will not be displayed on the page.

fields.name: iconImageAlt
fields.label: Network name
fields.description: e.g. Facebook: read out by screen readers, and shown as the link in the Variant B layout. At most 30 characters. Warning: The icon, its network name and its URL must all be provided. If one is missing, the icon will not be displayed on the page.

fields.name: iconLink
fields.label: URL
fields.description: The JSW Motors profile on that network (full URL). Warning: The icon, its network name and its URL must all be provided. If one is missing, the icon will not be displayed on the page.
